title: Schedule a Reliable Sync Engine
prompt: Connect an idempotent outbox drain to unique WorkManager work with constraints, bounded retry, cancellation, progress checkpoints, logout handling, and WorkManager tests.
successCriteria: Repeated triggers create one active chain.
Process interruption repeats no logical mutation.
Transient and permanent outcomes schedule differently.
hints: Name the authoritative state and durable identity before selecting a library API.
Test the operation after cancellation, duplication, or process recreation.

starterCode.code: class SyncWorker(appContext: Context, params: WorkerParameters) : CoroutineWorker(appContext, params)

solutionOutline: Model the data, operation, failure, and recovery states explicitly.
Implement the transactional path and prove every adverse success criterion.
verification: Run deterministic persistence or protocol tests.
Inspect durable state after interruption and retry.
